ns2:section.sectionText: THIS COURSE WILL MEET IN ROOM 210A OF THE EDUCATION BUILDING. Contact Instructor for meeting details. This course will survey primary literature dealing with the psychological underpinnings of reading. Some topics to be included are the eye movements during reading, visual word recognition, syntactic parsing, syntactic and lexical ambiguity resolution, discourse processing, reading instruction, and reading in non-alphabetic orthographies.
